title: D₄ sphere-packing optimality conjecture
statement: The D₄ checkerboard packing is a densest unit-sphere packing in Euclidean dimension four.

counterexample.description: A positive-definite rational 4×4 Gram matrix whose lattice has minimum squared norm at least four and determinant strictly below 64. This is a unit-sphere lattice packing denser than scaled D₄.
